plans.text: Trip to the Japanese Alps in November, potentially including scenic routes and accommodations in Nagano Prefecture.
Invite friends who live in Tokyo to join the Nagano trip for a few days.
Stay in Matsumoto during the trip.
Visit the Japanese Alps Visitor Center.
Explore Matsumoto's traditional architecture and historical sites, including temples, shrines, and castles.
Visit the Japanese Alps Visitor Center and then head to Matsumoto Castle.
Take a stroll along Nawate Street after visiting Matsumoto Castle.
Visit the Matsumoto Folkcraft Museum if time permits.
Visit Zenko-ji Temple if time permits.
Plan a day trip to Yokohama.
Check out Minato Mirai 21 and the Red Brick Warehouse during the Yokohama day trip.
Check out Kawai Shrine when there is a chance.
Eat kanimeshi at Kanemasa and namashirasu at Tsukiji Itadori Uogashi Nihon-Ichi, and possibly stop by Yokohama Central Market for grilled squid during the Yokohama day trip.
Check out the Yokohama Oktoberfest and the Autumn Leaves Festival if they are happening during the trip.

superseded_plans.text: Try local Yokohama seafood during the day trip, such as kanimeshi or namashirasu.

preferences.text: Interested in experiencing traditional Japanese culture and history.
Enjoys the fall foliage in Tokyo.
